dataset: KhalidAlsantali/Arabic-SMS-Spam-Data (GPL-3.0) — texts are NOT redistributed here; ids index the de-duplicated file order used by rasd.eval.external_split.load()
scope: spam-labelled messages of the held-out TEST half only (73 messages)
annotator: single annotator (RASD engineering), annotated AFTER the engine and lexicon were frozen (commit b986ee3) and WITHOUT seeing system verdicts. Not expert-adjudicated; no inter-annotator agreement available.

criteria.fraud_clear: impersonates an institution and pushes a callback number / link, or announces a prize to be claimed by contacting the sender
criteria.fraud_probable: bait lure (investment, extra salary, fake government jobs, fake brand giveaway) behind an opaque link, no identifiable legitimate merchant
criteria.ambiguous: cannot be decided from the text alone
criteria.marketing: promotion by an identifiable merchant — unwanted perhaps, but not fraud; out of RASD's scope
